text: Hadal Darkfathom is a sea giant located in Siege of Boralus.
The Half-eaten Journal is found in the North Pass Caverns in Drustvar.
The Hag-Hunter Crossbow is a quest reward from And Justice For All.
Halfhill Kid is a ram located in Valley of the Four Winds. It screams like a human.

__NOTOC__ Hagashi is a vulpera innkeeper located at the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun. After vulpera adventurers proved their people's worth to the Horde, Kiro had Hagashi put together a small memento in appreciation of their efforts.
The Hall of Shadra is located in the Terrace of the Chosen in Dazar'alor.

.]] The Hall of Ancient Paths is the northeastern lower room of the Great Seal area. It contains the Horde's portal room and a training center. Greasemonkey Laborers bring crates and :Azerite crystals into the room.

The Hall of Chroniclers is a room in the Great Seal area. After completing each part of the A Loa of a Tale achievement, each tablet will appear in this room. Torga can also be seen here after the Horde War Campaign.

__NOTOC__ Hakasi is a vulpera initially found as a captive of the Faithless sethrak at the Serpent's Maw in Vol'dun. After being rescued by the player, he can be seen in the Vulpera Hideaway, conversing with Kipp.
Hagglin' Senjilak is a skeletal troll facing Xu'nanji over an overturned crate filled with treasure, between the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
The Hailstone Construct is a Drust construct world boss located at Iceveil Glacier in Drustvar.
Half-Eaten Sausages are pick pocketed primarily from humans in Kul Tiras.
Hakeem Kae Kazim is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

__NOTOC__ Hades Prescott is a human located in Mariner's Row in Boralus. She traveled to the Dragon Isles where she can be found at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores. The Fullsails Supply Chest is found at her side.
Halgiz is a goblin located in the Sand Bar in Zuldazar. He swims up and down above a Treasure Chest.
The Haglands Snowmelt was a quest reward from The Witchqueen.
The Haglands Ice Shard is a quest reward from The Witchqueen.

Hall of Castes is a building in Dazar'alor. The place houses an Altar of Gonk and an Altar of Pa'ku. This is also where the Casteless Zandalari have their status in society decided. Priestess Vulja tests their connection to the loa, granting them scholarships for priest training, should they show promise.
__NOTOC__ Haiphoon, the Great Tempest is an elemental appearing in water and air forms summoned by Drums of the Tempest in the Stormwright's Shelf in Sholazar Basin.
Hakbi the Risen is a skeletal troll located in Atal'Dazar in Zuldazar.

The Hall of Glory is Odyn's personal throne room within the Halls of Valor, sitting high above the rest of the halls. Here, those seeking the All-Father's blessing fight to prove themselves suitably valorous. The area is accessed via a mythical bridge known as the Ephemeral Way, which connects the Hall of Glory to the Hearth of Revelry. It was here, at the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, that mortal champions confronted God-King Skovald in battle for Odyn's favor, and thus the :Aegis of Aggramar. They would later also face Odyn himself, in preparation for an assault on Helheim and the Sea-Witch Helya.
The Hall of Glimmers is an enchanting and jewelcrafting shop located in the Terrace of Crafters in Dazar'alor.
Hai'zujin is a jungle troll located in Ironmaul Overlook in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Haggronar is a sea giant located behind Elun'alor Temple in Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar.
__NOTOC__ Haegol the Hammer is an ettin located in Sprucewood in Stormsong Valley.

Hacks & Fires is a magazine punblished by Sparkle Entertainment Lightning & Fireworks. It was made in a collaboration with (S.E.L.F.) and Blast Yesterday Expectations until (B.Y.E.) mysteriously disappeared; leaving (S.E.L.F.) to take full ownership.
__NOTOC__ Haetio is an Ascended kyrian located at Haetio's Solace in Bastion.
The Hall of Beasts is pet-battle shop located in Dazar'alor.
Halkias is the first boss of the Halls of Atonement. The Shards of Halkias must be dealt with first.
Hadley is a stone fiend located in Darkhaven in Revendreth. Cassidy is found tossing a canister of anima back and forth to Cassidy.
Halen's Ritual Drafts drop from Architect Halen in Maldraxxus.
Halesteel Obernolte is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.
Hackney is a chef for House Proudmoore within Boralus. Katherine Proudmoore found his ravenberry tart scrumptious.
The Hall of Golems is hidden away behind a waterfall between the Terrace of Crafters and the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. Three Ancient Stone Golem are found here, along with the Cache of Secrets.
The Hailstone Loop drops from Noth the Plaguebringer at the Fleshwerks in Icecrown during Death Rising.
The Hall of Shapes is Oribos' profession training and vendor area. All available professions (excluding Archaeology) can be trained.
Haliscan may refer to: *Haliscan Brimmed Hat *Haliscan Jacket *Haliscan Pantaloons *Pattern: Haliscan Jacket *Pattern: Haliscan Pantaloons
__NOTOC__ Halis's Lunch Pail is located next to Chef Cookie in the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus.
The Hall of Holding is the location of the bank, guild bank, and Great Vault (weekly chest) of Oribos.

The Hall of Curiosities is the southeast room of the Ring of Fates in Oribos and is a bazaar of Cartel Ta. Various services are found here, including the Barbershop, Stable master, Transmogrification, Void Storage, and some specialty vendors.
Haephus is an Ascended kyrian located in Elysian Hold in Bastion.
The Hairy Egg is looted from the Strange Growth in the Forgotten Wounds in Maldraxxus. After three days the egg will hatch into a Bloodlouse Larva.
Hadal's Nautilus drops from Hadal Darkfathom in the Siege of Boralus.
The Hall of Illusions is a room found in Scholomance. Jandice Barov is fought here.

The Hall of Spirits is the main building in Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. By the time of the end of the Fourth War, the biggest building in the rise was renamed to Cloudsong Sanctum, home of the Cloudsong tribe. After the war, it was visited by Zekhan and Rexxar.
The Hall of Elders is the main building in Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
The Halberd of the Unwary Guard drops from The Sand Queen in Tol Dagor.
__NOTOC__ Hala is a kyrian located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Half-Eaten Supplies were the objective of NOT USED REUSE ME (2) during development.

The Hall of Chains is a building at the southeastern end of the Separation Chamber where corpses and still-living subjects are kept until ready for dismemberment at the Separation Chamber. Later, surgeons of the House of Constructs work to complete kyrian abominations as the combined forces of the Kyrians and loyal Necrolords siege the house.
Hakkar's Husk is the remains of Hakkar the Soulflayer's missing wildseed. It is found in the Tranquil Pools in Ardenweald.
Half a Dissolved Letter is looted from a Suspicious Communication at the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus.

Half-Completed Runeforge Pattern can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 48 Cataloged Research and 24 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Halia was a young mermaid and one of the two main characters in the Kul Tiran folktale "Why the Mermaids Left Boralus", which tells of the love between her and the tidesage Ery.
Haetio's Solace is located in northwestern Bastion. It is the location of Haetio and other kyrians who were serving at Kalliope's Rest before the Forsworn invaded.
Half-Finished Mummies are Zandalari troll mummies located in Kings' Rest.
Halberd of the Aranakk drops from Domina Venomblade in Plaguefall.
Halkias's Towering Pillars drop from Halkias in the Halls of Atonement.
Halfhill Goatherds are pandaren located in and around Halfhill and the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds. They tend to Shaghorns.
Halfdan Sly-Stalker is a vrykul located in the Great Mead Hall in Skyhold during A Hate-Hate Relationship. He is seen facing off against Drithen the Boisterous, encircled by many Valarjar Aspirants.
Hakkari Revenant's Grips drop from Hakkar the Soulflayer in De Other Side.

Hacksaw Skinning Knife is an appearance unlocked as a quest reward from Mojambo (quest).
Hammerfall is a Horde base in the Arathi Highlands. It is an unofficial refuge for discontents who feel they have no place in the current world.

Hallow's End is an annual Halloween-inspired seasonal event that takes place during the latter half of October. :"When the decorations of Hallow's End light up Azeroth's cities, you know there's mischief afoot! Seek special vendors in Orgrimmar or Ironforge and get your hands on treats! Aid a sick orphan in a little trick-or-treating! Darkcaller Yanka, attending the Forsaken's Wickerman Festival, and Sergeant Hartman of Southshore are seeking your aid in keeping the enemy out of their holiday affairs - are you up to the challenge?"

Hammertoe's Digsite lies in the northern part of the Badlands. The dig has recently been abandoned by Hammertoe and taken over by a gang of Dark Irons, presumably part of the same force that has moved into Uldaman.
Hammer of the Titans is crafted with Blacksmithing (300); taught by Plans: Hammer of the Titans, a drop from Maleki the Pallid in the Stratholme.
Hammer of Ji'zhi is a two-handed mace primarily for druids, paladins, and shamans
Hammer of the Gathering Storm is part of the Gift of the Gathering Storm set.
__NOTOC__ Halo of Transcendence is part of the Vestments of Transcendence, the raid Tier 2 armor set for Priests.

The Hall of the Brave is a large barracks located in the Valley of Honor in the orc capital of Orgrimmar. The Hall contains many of the Horde's army officers, warrior trainers, and battlemasters. Several training dummies are located throughout the building, inside and out. It was referred to as the warriors' guild house. The previous barracks was a single floor building with an interior that mostly matched the Hall of Legends. It was rebuilt using the new and improved orc architecture, that was first seen in Northrend. After the introduction of the into the Horde, they can be found throughout the hall, using it as an impromptu home. New Mag'har characters start just outside of this building.

Hanashi was a jungle troll located in the Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. He was a weapon master, and taught the skill to wield the following: *Bows *Thrown Weapons *One-handed axes *Two-handed axes *Staves

Hammer of Bestial Fury is an mace that dropped from the Dragons of Nightmare: Lethon, Emeriss, Ysondre, and Taerar. During the Warcraft's Anniversary event, the dragons return to Azeroth and can drop a level-scaled version of this item.
Hana'zua is a jungle troll quest giver located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

Hammer of the Northern Wind is a main-hand hammer with a Frostbolt proc.
The Hand of Edward the Odd is an one-handed mace whose proc enables the next spell cast to be cast more quickly.

The Hand of Argus is an organization of draenei paladins and vindicators that serve as the primary military and police force of the Exodar draenei. Before the third invasion of the Burning Legion, they were mostly present and active in Bloodmyst Isle, where the greatest of the Exodar's crash corruption on the Azuremyst Isles had taken hold. They are considered elite among the draenei. The Hand of Argus is led by the Triumvirate of the Hand — Vindicators Boros, Kuros and Aesom. They are based in the Exodar, and stationed in Blood Watch on Bloodmyst Isle. Hama is a draenei tailoring trainer and vendor located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula. She can be found on the second floor of the inn.

Hall of the Keepers is located inside Uldaman, on the other side of the instance portal from Dig One. Like many other parts of the dungeon, it is crawling with troggs. The hall leads south to Dig Two, and west to the Map Chamber. It is also the location of Uldaman's first boss, Revelosh, who carries the Shaft of Tsol needed to release Ironaya, as well as the Remains of a Paladin. After the Cataclysm, expeditions from the Reliquary and the Explorers' League entered the Hall.

The Hall of the Crafters is located inside Uldaman, beyond the tunnel system leading from the Stone Vault. It is infested with earthen and golems, and is the only way to access Khaz'goroth's Seat, where the dungeon's last boss, the stone giant Archaedas, resides. At least 3 people must be present in order to get the final temple doors open.
Hameya's Key drops from Infiltrator Hameya in the Eastern Plaguelands.

The Hall of the Cursed is located inside the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. It is accessed by going upstairs from the center-right or center-left exits in the first room after the instance portal. The hall itself is full of Atal'ai trolls, grell servants, and fierce dire trolls. In order to kill Jammal'an, one must first kill Gasher, Hukku, Loro, Mijan, Zolo, and Zul'Lor, who stand on the six ledges overlooking the Pit of Sacrifice. These mini-bosses can only be reached by going through the Hall of the Cursed. Once all six are dead, the shield protecting Jammal'an will fade, and he will be reachable. The order of the mini-bosses does not matter, unlike the serpent statues in Hall of Serpents.

The Halls of the Law is located inside Blackrock Depths, and is accessible from the Detention Block. They are the tunnel system that surrounds the Ring of the Law, and clearing them out is a necessity if you want to do Marshal Windsor's escort quest, Jail Break!.

The Halls of Destruction is an area of Dire Maul North, located behind the Gordok Courtyard Door. The first two areas are unnamed, open courtyards full of ogres, stealth-detecting hyenas, and the mini-bosses Guard Mol'dar, Stomper Kreeg and Guard Fengus. Mol'dar drops the Gordok Courtyard Key, which is required to open the Gordok Courtyard Door (alternative methods like pick lock and seaforium charges can also be used). Beyond lie the Halls of Destruction, full of more ogres, doomguard pets, and Knot Thimblejack, a hapless goblin prisoner who will offer a few alternate ways of becoming king of Dire Maul, by clever use of traps and disguise. The Hall of the Damned is located deep within Scholomance. It is accessed from the Headmaster's Study via the eastern doorway on the upper level. This is where the evil Doctor Theolen Krastinov can be found, amid a few pestilent ghouls.

Halycon's Lair is an area of Lower Blackrock Spire, and the domain of the Halycon and Gizrul the Slavener. They breed a pack of fierce worgs that the Blackrock orcs use as mounts and pets. In return, Halycon and her brood are fed captured Dark Iron dwarves, whose gnawed carcasses litter the cave floor. Halycon's Lair is found to the right upstairs from Urok Doomhowl's ledge. The Storehouse is left down the hall.

The title Hand of A'dal was introduced in Patch 2.4.0 and was available to players who complete, or have completed, the attunement quests for Mount Hyjal (The Vials of Eternity) and Black Temple (Medallion of Karabor). According to Eyonix, this title was not going to be available to players beyond level 70 in the Wrath of the Lich King expansion, to prevent easy access to the title. This was clarified by Tigole, who stated that the title would not be available once patch 3.0.X arrived. On October 15, 2008, Blizzard introduced Patch 3.0.2 which removed this title along with the Champion of the Naaru title, for the reasons stated above. Hands of the Deceiver are elite man'ari eredar located in the Sunwell Plateau of the Isle of Quel'Danas. They can also be spotted from the Magisters' Terrace through the use of the Scrying Orb located at The Solar Vigil. After their death, the fight against Kil'jaeden will start.

Halls of Anguish is a part of the Black Temple where fel orcs of the Bonechewer clan reside. It splits off into the Shrine of Lost Souls and a nameless fountain-filled basement where Gurtogg Bloodboil resides. Once Gurtogg is dead, a door opens revealing a shortcut back to the halls.
The Hammer Pick is a combination mining pick and blacksmithing hammer.
The Hammer of Grief drops from Maiden of Grief in the Halls of Stone on heroic mode.
The Hammer of the Astral Plane drops from Kel'Thuzad in the 10-man version of Naxxramas.
The Hall of the Shaper is located on the eastern side of the Terrace of the Makers in the Storm Peaks.
Hammer of the Righteous is a Protection paladin talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Blessed Hammer.
Halls of Mourning is the last room in Sethekk Halls. Talon King Ikiss is found here.

The Halls of Silence is the first room entered on the second floor within Sethekk Halls. Several undead arakkoa can be found here alongside living ones. On heroic, the room past the halls is home to Anzu.

Hallowed Be Thy Name is related to the seasonal world event Hallow's End. If you complete this achievement you will be rewarded with the title . Completing this achievement is a criterion for the meta-achievement What a Long, Strange Trip It's Been.

Halof the Deathbringer is a level 80 elite frost vrykul that spawns during the quest The Battle For Crusaders' Pinnacle. Slaying him completes the defense of the Blessed Banner of the Crusade, and the Battle for Crusader's Pinnacle.
Hall of the High Father is the large hallway that leads throughout Halls of Stone, likely named after Aman'thul, leader of the Pantheon. pl:Hall of the High Father
Hand-Mounted Pyro Rocket is an engineer-only permanent "enchant" to gloves. This item takes the same "spot" as an enchant from Enchanting.
The Hall of the Watchers is a long hallway between the Iron Crucible and Thundering Overlook within the Halls of Lightning.
Halona Stormwhisper is a stable master located in Taunka'le Village in the eastern Borean Tundra.
The Hall of the Conquered Kings is the massive entrance within Ahn'kahet. Elder Nadox can be found here.
Halsand was the husband of Myra and the father of Jake, Rose and Tulip. He lived as a poor farmer in his estate until one day, everything changed.

The Halls of Winter is a subzone of Ulduar. Hodir resides within here. The Halls are available after the defeat of Auriaya at the Observation Ring and its entrance is denoted by the blue-white snowflake at the 5 o'clock (southeast) exit of the Observation Ring.
This is a page listing loot to be found in the Halls of Lightning. For information about the instance itself, see Halls of Lightning.
This is a page listing loot to be found in the Halls of Stone. For information about the instance itself, see Halls of Stone.

The Halls of Reanimation is the final room of the Construct Quarter in Naxxramas. Here Thaddius stands immobile at the end of the room, kept pacified by tesla coils linked to the wights Feugen and Stalagg.

The Halls of Origination in Uldum is a level-85 five-player dungeon available in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm, featuring an unparalleled journey through the timeless titan construction and seven unique boss fights. Hidden deep within its halls lies an ancient treasure that, if placed in the wrong hands, could endanger all life on Azeroth. Should players survive the perils of Uldum, they will be called to help Brann Bronzebeard unlock the mysteries within these treacherous titan halls and protect the titans' ancient secrets. A non-linear dungeon, the Halls' entrance can be found at of eastern Uldum inside the large pyramid. Outside the pyramid are four massive statues, placed as if acting lik
Halls of Theory is an area inside Magisters' Terrace. The hallways are a ground for large swarms of Brightscale Wyrm, with Vexallus guarding the exit at the other end of the hallway.

The Halls of Reflection is the third and last wing of the Frozen Halls of Icecrown Citadel, released in patch 3.3. It was considered the hardest 5-man instance of the expansion, due to the difficulty and loot. The Halls of Reflection are the private chambers of the Lich King, the only place where he lets his guard down. Judging by the loading screen and map, it appears to be a dark, twisted replica of Lordaeron's imperial chamber. To become attuned and unlock the doors to the Halls of Reflection, players are required to complete the quest Deliverance from the Pit in the Pit of Saron as part of the Frozen Halls story line quest chain. Hammerfall Elites are orcs who guards Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Hammerfall Grunts are orc guards found in Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.
Hammerfall Guardians are level 50 orcs who guards Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.
Hammerfall Peons are orcs located at the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.
Hammerhead Oils can be extracted from dead Spinescale Hammerheads in Seabrush in Abyssal Depths with Oil Extrusion Pump.
Hammerfoot's Plate Leggings are a quest reward from A Pilot's Revenge.
Hammer of the Thorium Brotherhood is a quest reward from Welcome to the Brotherhood.
Hallowed Ground was a Protection paladin talent that increases the damage of Consecration and decreases its mana cost by a significant amount.

The Halls of Strife are the rooms between the Shadow Wing Lair, where Vaelastrasz the Corrupt was encountered, and the Crimson Laboratories of Blackwing Lair. The first room has two Death Talon packs of dragonspawn, and the rooms after that are the gauntlet before Broodlord Lashlayer. It is infamous for the Suppression Devices and difficulty of the gauntlet in vanilla. See Broodlord Lashlayer → The suppression rooms for more information on the gauntlet run.

Hammond Farmstead was a farm located west and downhill of Duskhaven, in southwestern Gilneas. Melinda Hammond owned the farmstead where she grew corn. Next door, to the south, was Allen Farmstead. The two properties were divided by an ominous fissure in the ground right before the Cataclysm. Along with the Duskmist Shore, these were the first sections to fall into the sea.

After his death just before the War of the Three Hammers, the hammer mysteriously disappeared. Centuries later, a scroll was found in the Ironforge library that stated that the hammer had been broken into three pieces. During the chaos of the war, each clan had, in one way or another, managed to obtain one of the fragments: *The Wildhammer clan obtained the handle, taken by one of their clan and reforged into a scepter carried by Thane Khardros, passing it on to Thane Kurdran. *The Bronzebeard clan obtained the hammer
Hanbal is a level 83 tol'vir inscription and tailoring supplies vendor located in Mar'at of Uldum.
Hands of the Queen are hostile hands summoned by Queen Azshara in the Well of Eternity.
The Hall of Twilight is the third and last room in the Mana-Tombs instance. Nexus-Prince Shaffar is fought here, and his supposed 'gift' Yor is bound in a stasis chamber on heroic.

Han Stormstout is a pandaren of the prestigious Stormstout dynasty, and one of the few Stormstout members to venture into the Dread Wastes. Though encased in amber when you meet him, you can release him by pouring a Mug of Dreadbrew on the amber. Han can be later seen in the Celestial Court in the Timeless Isle. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he traveled to the Wandering Isle and was seen in the Laughing Crane. During the Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, he was located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

The Hall of Tiles can be found inside the Guo-Lai Halls, down the ramp and straight back. Past the hallway and trapped room is the Ancient Guo-Lai Door leading to the Hall of the Serpent on the lower level.
The Hall of the Serpent is the lower level of the Guo-Lai Halls, accessed via the Hall of Tiles down the ramp and straight back.
Han Flowerbloom is a pandaren herbalism trainer located in the Halfhill Market of Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Hambone is the boar located at the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn. It would seem that the Explorers' League have begun training boars to oppose the wilderness of Stranglethorn.

Hall of the Defamed is the western of the two southern crypts in the Court of Bones on the southwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. To the east is the Hall of the Exalted and the Hall of the Grand Imperion is to the south. Three Shan'ze Thundercallers are channeling something into a lightning rod at the chamber's northern end.

Hall of the Exalted is the eastern of the two southern crypts in the Court of Bones on the southwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. To the west is the Hall of the Defamed and the Hall of the Grand Imperion is to the south.

Hall of the Grand Imperion is the southermost crypt in the Court of Bones on the southwestern side of the Isle of Thunder. To the north are the Hall of the Defamed and the Hall of the Exalted, and to the south is Za'Tual.

The Halls of Valor (sometimes called the Hall of Valor, known as Valhalas or Valhallas in Vrykul) are said to be located high up in the clouds above Stormheim, however, they are also mentioned to be above Helya's realm of Helheim. This is where the greatest warriors of the vrykul are called to serve Keeper Odyn as their eternal reward for being the worthiest. As you are seeking out the Pillar of Creation in Stormheim, you are contending with the Burning Legion cooperating leader of the vrykul in Stormheim, the God-King Skovald. As you race against him through the region, both of your paths lead you to this dungeon, which is the location of the Pillar. You must prove yourself worthy in battle

The Halls of the Boundless Reach are entered through a portal near the base of the central tower of Antorus, and it is in all likelihood that tower's interior, though exactly where it is located is unknown.
